description: This file is a utility script for processing and rendering release notes for the Playwright project. It reads markdown files, parses API documentation, adjusts heading levels, and filters content based on version and language.

methods.name: parseApi
methods.description: Parses API documentation from specified files and returns structured data.

methods.name: visitAll
methods.description: Traverses all nodes in a markdown AST and applies a callback.

methods.name: renderPlaywrightDevLinks
methods.description: Renders development links within the markdown content.

methods.name: docsLinkRendererForLanguage
methods.description: Returns a link renderer function tailored for a specific language.

methods.name: languageToRelativeDocsPath
methods.description: Converts a language identifier to its documentation path.
